introduction.p1: My name is Eric, I am 23 years old and I have been passionate about computer science for over a decade. Currently, I hold a degree in computer science.
introduction.p2: My goal is to become a full stack developer, specializing in web development (Java/Python/Angular/React), while also exploring cybersecurity, DevOps, and mobile app development.

services.title: UI/UX Design
services.p: An effective UI/UX is what captures attention and spreads a clear message. I ensure the design is innovative and neat with all of this.

services.title: Web Development
services.p: If you are looking for a developer who will take over the research and development of your website, I am a well-established professional to help you with this.

services.title: App Development
services.p: If you are looking for a user-friendly app that will attract more mobile users, I can help you design and build a platform with the latest and trendiest look and feel.

projects.title: Multiplayer Strategic Board Game
projects.name: Library
projects.desc: Created a strategic board game in Java. Each player controls a territory defined by squares of their color and must manage gold, build structures, and command soldiers. The game system includes an economy based on resources acquired and gold earned each turn.

projects.title: Air Traffic Simulator
projects.name: Library
projects.desc: This simulator aims to model the movements and interactions of airplanes within a predefined airspace. Developed in Java, it uses multithreading to manage planes simultaneously. The simulation is represented in a 2D graphical interface where the user can observe flight paths, airport data, and real-time information on aircraft position, speed, and altitude.

projects.title: Educational App for Students
projects.name: Library
projects.desc: Developed an interactive app in Python to teach programming to students. The game is structured in chapters and levels with progressive difficulty, covering concepts such as data types, loops, variables, and conditions. The user codes directly in an editor integrated into the game.
